messages:
maria: quick async standup — evening shift

what I did: pushed prefetch-window tweak to kernel (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1428), added safer slot reclaim path, ran a small kv-warmup smokebench on canary. saw ~12% throughput bump on our microbatch trace.

blockers: noticed p95 tail for long contexts (~8k tokens) spiking intermittently on canary after tweak, seems correlated with slot handoff edge-case. need extra eyes on the reclamation race.

today: rolling the fix to a single canary shard, will instrument more traces and heatmaps. pinging @ash and @devon for review + logs.

ash: saw the same p95 blips earlier. i dumped kv metrics — eviction count spikes when two priming tasks overlap. adding guard to prefetch to avoid double-priming. leaving a short note in the PR. :nerd_face:

devon: grabbing logs now. ran the reproducer locally — saw this stack in the worker:```
2026-02-10T19:02:11.234Z worker-3 ERROR reclaim: slot already freed but referenced
stack: runtime/slot.go:412 -> kernel/prefetch.go:128 -> main.go:77
```
that aligns w/ the race hypothesis. i'll add an assertion and a stress test.

maria: thanks — if you can add a minimal unit that forces concurrent prefetch + reclaim that'd be ideal. also if we can get bench-bot to rerun the 8k token trace after the assert, we can see if tail stabilizes.

bench-bot: scheduled microtrace run (8k tokens) on canary shard-4 — job 7752 queued. ETA ~6m.

kai: small heads-up — i adjusted batcher slotting heuristics earlier today (reduce max-slot-hold from 120ms to 80ms). that might interact with reclaim. reverting the change on canary would help isolate.

maria: OK reverting on canary-4 now. will coordinate with devon so revert + assert + rerun are in same window.

devon: PR updated with assertion + stress test, left review comments for maria on the guard. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1431

ash: lgtm on the guard, left a nit about metrics naming. once merged, can we add a new counter `prefetch_double_start` so we can track frequency?

maria: will add counter in follow-up patch. for now i'll merge the revert, then merge devon's fix, then trigger bench-bot.

ops-bot: deploy canary-4 revert -> success (image: runtime-canary:2026-02-10-evictfix).

bench-bot: microtrace run complete: baseline p95=92ms -> canary p95=79ms, p50 unchanged. small tail improvements but still 3 small spikes observed (investigating).

maria: nice improvement overall. devon, can you run the stress test against canary images and post the first 200 lines of the stress runner log here? if we don't see the race under stress, might be infra noise.

devon: stress run started. will drop logs when finished. should be ~8m.

ash: FYI i'll follow up tomorrow with a dashboard panel for `prefetch_double_start` once we have it — will help catch regressions early. :eyes:

maria: great. blockers for me are cleared for tonight. next steps documented in the PRs. thanks team! :tada:
